stance.label: Hyperliquid risk under review
stance.summary: HYPE fell 8.4% in 24 hours while Hyperliquid addressed an oracle anomaly tied to $57 million of equity-perpetual liquidations. ARC reports $420 on the venue.

market.oneLine: The relevant event is not a generic market lesson: it is a sharp HYPE move plus a fresh oracle incident at a venue holding ARC capital.

insights.headline: HYPE drops 8.4% as Hyperliquid explains a $57M oracle event
insights.summary: HYPE traded at $54.46 after an 8.4% 24-hour decline. Hyperliquid said an oracle anomaly triggered roughly $57 million of SK Hynix perpetual liquidations.
insights.portfolioRelevance: ARC reports $420 on Hyperliquid, about 0.7% of the $62,385 portfolio. This is venue exposure; the source does not prove ARC owns HYPE.

insights.headline: ETH falls 3.4%, but portfolio impact cannot yet be attributed
insights.summary: ETH traded near $1,878 after a 3.4% 24-hour decline. The move matters to Base collateral and lending buffers, but the wallet feed does not itemize ARC's ETH balance.
insights.portfolioRelevance: Monitor lending health and collateral sensitivity. Do not publish a dollar-loss estimate until token-level holdings are available.

insights.headline: $ARC is nearly flat; exit liquidity remains the larger signal
insights.summary: $ARC moved 0.3% over 24 hours at roughly $0.001561, while tracked DEX liquidity was approximately $15,155.
insights.portfolioRelevance: This is not a material price event. Thin liquidity still limits how much self-token value can be treated as realizable treasury capital.

risks.label: Hyperliquid oracle reliability
risks.detail: A fresh oracle anomaly reportedly triggered $57 million of liquidations in an equity perpetual market.
risks.trigger: Escalate on another oracle incident, withdrawal impairment, or any increase in ARC venue exposure.

risks.label: Portfolio attribution
risks.detail: The wallet source reports $57,644 of liquid capital without token-level balances.
risks.trigger: Do not convert asset price moves into portfolio P&L until comparable holdings are available.

risks.label: $ARC exit liquidity
risks.detail: Tracked DEX liquidity is approximately $15,155, far below reported portfolio NAV.
risks.trigger: Treat self-token inventory as non-liquid unless an executable exit quote proves otherwise.
